---
title: "Analise Estatistica"
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-roc
#| fig-cap: "Curva ilustrativa sintética; não representa um modelo avaliado."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fpr, tpr = np.linspace(0, 1, 10), np.linspace(0, 1, 10) ** 0.7
auc = float(((fpr[1:] - fpr[:-1]) * (tpr[1:] + tpr[:-1]) / 2).sum())
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'AUC ilustrativa = {auc:.3f}')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', alpha=0.3)
plt.xlabel('FPR'); plt.ylabel('TPR'); plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
